title: Platelet disorders 3: thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (immune and congenital)

units.name: Introduction
units.assessment: Can you define the triad that must be present before you call a thrombotic microangiopathy TTP, and name the ADAMTS13 activity threshold that separates TTP from every other TMA?

lesson.title: Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (TTP) Part 1: Basics
lesson.why: A compact orientation to the disease definition — thrombocytopenia, microangiopathic hemolysis and the ADAMTS13 defect — before the chapter goes into mechanism and therapy.

drills.name: Where TTP sits among the thrombotic microangiopathies
drills.title: Thrombotic Microangiopathies with a Focus on TTP (Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura)

units.name: Pathogenesis
units.assessment: Can you explain why loss of ADAMTS13 activity produces platelet-rich microvascular thrombi, and describe how the mechanism differs between autoantibody-mediated and biallelic-mutation disease?

lesson.title: ISTH Academy Presentation: Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (TTP)
lesson.why: An ISTH academy lecture that works through VWF multimer biology, ADAMTS13 cleavage and the autoantibody response in the depth this section demands.

drills.name: Pathogenesis seen through a paediatric iTTP case
drills.title: IFCC Clinical Case 3：Immune mediated thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura TTP in pediatrics — Argenti

units.name: Clinical features
units.assessment: Given anemia, thrombocytopenia and schistocytes, can you list the features that favour TTP over complement-mediated HUS, DIC, HELLP or drug-induced TMA, and name a score that estimates the probability of severe ADAMTS13 deficiency?

lesson.title: Clinical Updates on Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (TTP)
lesson.why: Mayo Clinic Laboratories walks through the presenting features and the diagnostic laboratory sequence, which is exactly the discrimination problem this section poses.

drills.name: Full differential of the thrombotic microangiopathies
drills.title: Thrombotic Microangiopathies with a Focus on TTP (Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura)

units.name: Management
units.assessment: Can you state what must be started within hours of suspecting immune TTP before ADAMTS13 results return, say what caplacizumab adds and what it does not, and explain how congenital disease is treated differently?

lesson.title: Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (TTP) Part 3: Management
lesson.why: Covers the modern treatment stack — plasma exchange, corticosteroids, rituximab and caplacizumab — in the order it is actually applied.

drills.name: TTP in pregnancy, from a TTP referral centre
drills.title: TTP diagnosis & management in pregnancy - Prof Marie Scully

drills.name: Extended lecture on diagnosis through long-term follow-up
